description: Whether the tests of a change fail without the rest of the change.

outcome.description: proven: a test check fails on the tree with the non-test changes reverted. not_proven: they all pass. inconclusive: the tests could not be measured. The others: nothing to measure.

reason.description: Why, as a code: for example tests_fail_without_the_change, after_not_green or no_test_check.

test_files.description: The changed paths that are tests; they stay as they are.

reverted_files.description: The changed paths that are not tests and were set back to the commit while the tests ran.

after.description: The id of the gate result for the current tree; empty when the tree was not measured.

reverted.description: The gate result of the reverted tree; null when nothing was reverted.

restored.description: True when the tree and the index are as they were: always, for a result that is not a failure.
